title: Expected timing
local: Times use this device’s time zone.
planned: Planned entries require a manual start when due. Prices and evidence must be checked again.
legacy: This older play has no recorded plan times. Set a schedule before entering.
future: Entry is planned for later. Return when due to review and start it.
expired: The planned exit has passed. Edit the schedule before entering.
lead: Plan a day ahead where possible; new entry times must be at least three hours ahead.
invalid: Choose an entry time and an exit time after it.
tooSoon: Choose an entry time at least three hours ahead.
